messages.subject: May time recording - please finalise by Monday
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi all,

Month-end is upon us. Please ensure all May time is recorded and released by 10am Monday 2 June so we can run the WIP report and the June bills. Several matters in the team still show gaps for the last week of May.

Thank you,
Accounts | Whitfield Carter LLP
